Name: Dr. Disha Soni
Bio: Dr. Disha Soni is a passionate and committed physiotherapist with two years of expertise improving patient lives with excellent care. Professional Background- *Specialization:* Traumatic and Non-Traumatic Post-Op Physiotherapy- *Experience:* 2 years- *Education:* Bachelors of Physiotherapy,- Ahmedabad physiotherapy college‍Expertise- Traumatic Physiotherapy (e.g., spinal injuries, orthopedic conditions)- Non-Traumatic Post-Op Physiotherapy (e.g., joint replacements, surgeries)- Rehabilitation and Recovery- Pain Management- Injury Prevention‍Approach‍Dr. Disha Soni advocates individualized care, creating treatment programs to meet the specific requirements of every patient. Her mission is to enable people to reach their full potential in terms of mobility, well-being, and physical function.*Professional philosophy* Dr. Disha Soni works constantly to provide her patients with evidence-based, empathetic care that builds their confidence. Together, let's strive for a happier, healthier one's self!‍

Name: Dr.Dimple Parmar
Bio: I am Dimple Parmar, BPT, MPT (Sports Science), GSCPT. With a strong passion for orthopedic and vascular conditions, I bring four years of dedicated experience to the field of physiotherapy. Throughout my career, I have had the privilege of treating a wide variety of patients suffering from joint pain and vascular issues. I am committed to applying my expertise with compassion and precision, helping patients recover from their painful conditions and significantly improve their quality of life. My approach is not just about adding years to life but enhancing the life in those years.

Name: Dr.Payal Vadlani
Bio: Dr. Payal Vadlani is a passionate and highly motivated physiotherapy professional who earned her Bachelor of Physiotherapy from L.J. College of Physiotherapy. With a solid academic background and a deep commitment to patient well-being, she strives to deliver high-quality, evidence-based care tailored to individual needs.She has developed a keen interest in the assessment and management of vascular conditions, joint pain, and non-surgical treatments. Her clinical approach emphasizes accurate diagnosis, patient education, and customized treatment plans that focus on pain relief, restoring mobility, and preventing recurrence. She believes in empowering patients through awareness and active participation in their recovery process.
